Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1991. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
